detail.longDescription:
Has anyone successfully built a non-root (aka rootless) capable exim container? Can I copy your homework?

I've kindof got one here, https://git.open.engineering/oeng/exim-docker

but it never seem to work quite right, like I run exim in the container I get:

 exim@c32a68ffb27a:/$ exim -bd exim: permission denied; not admin 

But I'm not sure why. All of /etc/exim4 is chgrped to exim, so is the binary itself at /usr/sbin/exim4.... what in the world am I missing?

Edit 1: Please don't tell me to read the manual or do a web search. I've been searching for hours and can't find what I need. I came here to ask for help.

Edit 2: It's working! (well, not like, totally working, because I have to fix TLS stuff, but it's officially running as non-root so we are moving! :heart_cyber: )
